name: Staplers and Sutures Daily Sales
query:
Select
'Stapler' item_code,
sum(`tabSales Invoice Item`.qty) as "Quantity:Float/Quantity:200",
sum(ROUND(`tabSales Invoice Item`.base_net_amount,0)) as "Amount:Currency/Amount:200"
from `tabSales Invoice Item`
left join `tabSales Invoice` on `tabSales Invoice`.`name` = `tabSales Invoice Item`.`parent`
Where
`tabSales Invoice`.docstatus=1
and Item_code="SS35W"
and `tabSales Invoice`.`posting_date` BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
union
Select
'Sutures' item_code,
sum(`tabSales Invoice Item`.qty) as "Quantity:Float/Quantity:200",
sum(ROUND(`tabSales Invoice Item`.base_net_amount,0)) as "Amount:Currency/Amount:200"
from `tabSales Invoice Item`
left join `tabSales Invoice` on `tabSales Invoice`.`name` = `tabSales Invoice Item`.`parent`
Where
`tabSales Invoice`.docstatus=1
and Item_code!="SS35W"
and `tabSales Invoice`.`posting_date` BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
